newsitem.title: USA: Sports Club sells stock to Millennium.
newsitem.headline: Sports Club sells stock to Millennium.

text.p: The Sports Club Co Inc said on Monday it signed a deal to sell over 2.1 million shares of common stock to Millennium Entertainment Partners LP for $5.0 million in cash and other assets.
The other assets include a 9.9 percent ownership stake in a $2.5 million note from Reebok/Sports Club NY partnership.

"Millennium Entertainment Partners is a highly successful developer of up-scale urban entertainment and residential properties, and has been a contributing partner in our successful New York club," Michael Talla, chief executive officer, said in a written statement.

The Sports Club also said it signed a letter of intent to jointly develop Sports Clubs in Washington, D.C. and San Francisco on properties currently under development by an affiliate of Millennium Entertainment Partners.
The company expects to complete leases within 30 days and start construction in late 1997. The clubs are not expected to generate revenue or expenses during 1997 or 1998.
